scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @wiut/contracts build && concurrently -k -n api,web 'pnpm --filter @wiut/api dev' 'pnpm --filter @wiut/web dev'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wiut/contracts build && pnpm --filter @wiut/api build && pnpm --filter @wiut/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @wiut/contracts build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @wiut/contracts build && pnpm --filter @wiut/contracts test && pnpm --filter @wiut/api test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm format:check
